title: AshA2ui Admin Catalog v3
description: Semantic admin components for AshA2ui surfaces (see notes/2026-09-07-admin-catalog-contract.md): the page shell, collection, task panel and feedback components, and the basic inputs and Modal this catalog renders itself. An admin surface names this catalog as its catalogId. TextField, CheckBox, ChoicePicker, DateTimeInput and Modal are declared here with the basic catalog's definitions, unchanged, and resolve from this catalog (the renderer draws its accessible inputs and the prompt Modal), so they carry no @catalogId. Every other basic component on an admin surface (Text, Button, Row, Column, Card, List, ...) carries the basic catalog's id as @catalogId and renders from the basic catalog, and the function calls inside a component name the catalog of their function when it is not this one. Selected with `config :ash_a2ui, :catalog, :admin_v1`. Dynamic properties are literals, {"@path": ...} bindings or function calls. The admin envelopes (row actions, row click, sort, pagination, calendar window) name an ash_a2ui action and its context; the renderer sends them as the ashAction function of the ash_a2ui catalog.

changelog.3.12.0: Additive: masked fields. A field the reader's field policies forbid arrives as the masked text ("Hidden", translated) and never as null or empty: the record's value for the field is that text and the record carries the reason under the reserved "_masked" key ({"<field>": "You do not have access to this value."}), listed for masked fields only (the convention of the reserved "_values" key). fieldDisplay gains an optional masked (a DataBinding) binding to the reason (/detail/<context>/_masked/<field> or /ui/panel/record/_masked/<field>): when it resolves to a non-empty string the value is drawn as plain text (format, link, badge, edit, emptyText and hideWhenEmpty are ignored: a value the reader may not see is not edited in place), the element is marked data-a2ui-masked, and the reason is its title and accessible description. A dataGrid column gains the same optional masked, a row-relative binding ({path: "_masked/<field>"}) shaped like its actionVisible (3.9), with the same meaning per cell. The server emits masked only for a field a field policy covers (Ash.Policy.Info.field_policies_for_field/2; for a source field, any resource along the path), so surfaces over resources without field policies are byte-for-byte unchanged. A renderer that ignores masked still shows the masked text, because the value itself is the masked text.
changelog.3.11.0: Additive: editing a record in place, saved by a save bar. A fieldDisplay may carry edit ({component, field, recordId, input, options?}: the card and field it edits, input one of text, integer, number, date or choice, options the choices) with editValue (the stored value the input starts from), editVisible (whether the record offers editing), editDraft (the person's unsaved change, /ui/edits/<card>/values/<field>) and editError (a refused save's message for it, /ui/edit_errors/<card>/<field>). While editVisible is true, choosing or focusing the value opens it as an input; Enter or leaving it writes a changed value to editDraft (and the card's recordId to /ui/edits/<card>/recordId), Escape drops the edit; a field with a draft shows the draft. Nothing is sent. The new saveBar component, last in an entityPage's children, shows while /ui/edits holds a change: its message (messageWaiting while fields under review still wait), a status tag counting them (status/statusOne, %{count} replaced), Discard (clears /ui/edits and /ui/edit_errors) and Save, which sends its action (save_changes, the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction) with choice save. With a confirm and fields still waiting, Save first opens a dialog: Cancel sends nothing, saveLabel sends choice save, thenLabel (when then is true and the bar's record's thenVisible field is true) sends choice then; with nothing waiting and thenWhenClear, Save sends choice then. A field counts as waiting while its review state is pending or missing, unless editReviews is true and it has a draft. A whole-model refresh keeps /ui/edits. Renderers that ignore edit draw the value read-only. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.10.0: Additive: pair reviews. A dataGrid column with pairs gains an optional items (a row-relative binding, {path: "_pairs_<field>"}, to the row's normalized pairs: a list of {term, value, key?, review?, action?}, review in the shape of a review field's (3.1), key the item's address in the record, action whether the item offers the column's pairAction, a boolean) and an optional pairAction (the field action of the column's field as a button per item: {label, action, context, icon?}, shaped like the column's action (3.9) and sent the same way, with the item's key added to the context as item when it is sent). A renderer draws each item's review after its value, and the button while the item's action is true; the server re-checks every call. A review summary's count also counts each item of such a column, in a table it counts, whose review still waits. Renderers that ignore them draw the pairs as before. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.9.0: Additive: row field actions. A dataGrid column gains an optional action (the field action of the column's field, a button in each row beside the value: {label, action, context, icon?}, shaped like fieldDisplay's action and a rowActions entry and sent the same way, as the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction; action is field_action and the context names the table (component) and the field, with recordId bound row-relatively to the row's id and query and contexts to the surface's) and an optional actionVisible (a row-relative binding, {path: "_action_<field>"}, to whether the row offers it, a boolean). A renderer draws the button only while the row offers it, dispatches the entry with its bindings resolved against the row, and holds it busy until the outcome; the server re-checks every call. A review summary's count also counts each row of a table filtered by its context alone that has a review field still waiting, once. Renderers that ignore them draw no button. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.8.0: Additive: a value and its document region linked both ways. A renderer marks the element it draws for a value that cites regions (a fieldDisplay with a review href, a dataGrid row with review cells) with data-a2ui-region, its value the reviews' hrefs separated by spaces. While a documentPane is shown with its document beside the sections, pointing at or focusing inside a marked element (or a link whose href starts with regionHref) shows its regions linked in the viewer, scrolling only the viewer's own canvas when the first is out of view; nothing is written, sent or focused, and leaving or blurring clears it. Activating a region (click, Enter or Space) also scrolls the page to the marked element citing it, flashes it for 3 seconds and, from the keyboard, moves focus to it. The state a linked region is drawn in is the renderer's (linked by default). Renderers that ignore the attribute draw as before. Nothing on the wire changes; the catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.7.0: Additive: live links. A page header breadcrumb step gains an optional live, navigate or patch: on a LiveView transport a plain primary click on the step follows its address inside the LiveView (navigate as push_navigate, patch as push_patch) instead of loading the page. The renderer marks the drawn link with the data-a2ui-live attribute (its value the kind) and the AshA2ui hook follows it, across shadow roots; a modified or middle click, a cross-origin address, a renderer that ignores live and a page without the hook follow href as a normal link. It is additive over 3.6.0. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.6.0: Additive: review summaries. alertBanner gains an optional count (a binding to how many of the surface's review fields still wait, pending or missing, on the record its context selects: /detail/<context>/_review_summary_<component>/count); with it, linkHref and linkLabel bind to the same summary's href (the section of the card holding the first waiting field in declaration order, its section nav #anchor when listed, or the declared fallback) and label. Renderers that ignore count draw the alert and its link. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.5.0: Additive: record pages a surface draws whole. entityPage gains an optional header (the page header the surface declares: breadcrumb, title, tags, meta and buttons, read from a context's record by field name; a button runs an action as the page_action ashAction, offered while the record's _header_action_<name> is true), lead (ids drawn full width under the header), leadVisible (per lead id, the path of a boolean gating it) and nav (a sticky section nav beside the children: a choice scrolls its section to the nav's line and outlines it, the section in view is marked, and an #anchor in a link or the address goes there once drawn). A host page's values are read at /page. New: alertBanner, a :detail drawn as an alert (variant, layout, title, message, link). It is additive over 3.4.0 (the document pane). Renderers that ignore the new props draw the plain heading and the children. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.4.0: Additive: document panes. New documentPane (a record's source document beside the surface's sections, with its own show/hide switch: document, shown and selected bind /detail/<context>/_document_<name> and /ui/documents/<name>; toggleAction is the document_pane event, sent with shown; a link in the children whose href starts with regionHref opens the pane at that region) and documentViewer (the PDF at src drawn with pdf.js, loaded only when a document opens, a text layer per page, zoom and page navigation, and regions {id, page, x, y, width, height, state, label?} as fractions of the page in the states pending, reviewed, selected, reviewed-selected, linked and empty; activating a region sends regionAction, the document_region event, with regionId). A review field's review may carry boxes ([{page, x, y, width, height}]), the regions its citation has. Renderers that do not know the new kinds report them as unknown; the catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.3.0: Additive: review fields in tables. dataGrid columns gain an optional review (row-relative, {path: "_review_<field>"}: the row's review of a review field the column draws, the same object fieldDisplay's review binds, {state, stateLabel, page?, pageLabel?, href?, quote?}, or null for none) and the subtitle binding an optional reviewPath (row-relative, the _review_<field> key of the subtitle's field). A renderer highlights a pending value and writes the state out beside the page tag (a link when href is present), in grids, list rows and cards alike. Renderers that ignore them draw the value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.2.0: Additive: field actions. fieldDisplay gains an optional action (a button beside the value: {label, action, context, icon?}, shaped like a dataGrid rowActions entry and sent the same way, as the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction; action is field_action and the context names the card (component) and the field, with recordId and contexts bound to the card's record and the selections; label is the action's name in words, translated, and icon an optional icon name the button may draw as, the label becoming its accessible name and tooltip) and an optional actionVisible (a binding to whether the record offers it, /detail/<context>/_action_<field>, a boolean). A renderer draws the button only while actionVisible is true and dispatches the entry with its bindings resolved; the server re-checks every call. Renderers that ignore them draw no button. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.1.0: Additive: review fields. fieldDisplay gains an optional review (a binding to a review field's review, /detail/<context>/_review_<field>: an object {state, stateLabel, page?, pageLabel?, href?, quote?}, state one of pending, reviewed or missing and stateLabel its words, translated; page the source page the value came from, pageLabel its tag ("p. 3"), href an address opening the source there and quote the words the value was read from; null for no review). A renderer highlights a pending value and writes the state out beside the page tag, linked when there is an href. Renderers that ignore it draw the value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.3.0.0: Breaking: the basic kinds this catalog renders itself move into it. TextField, CheckBox, ChoicePicker, DateTimeInput and Modal are declared here, with the basic catalog's definitions unchanged, and on an admin surface they carry no @catalogId: they resolve from this catalog, so a renderer draws its accessible inputs (a real label, the field's error beside the control) and the prompt Modal. Under 2.0.0 they carried the basic catalog's id and rendered from the basic catalog. Every other basic kind still carries the basic catalog's id. A function call inside a component on an admin surface names the basic catalog when its function is the basic catalog's. A renderer of 2.0.0 does not declare these kinds in the admin catalog and would reject or misplace them, so the catalogId moves to https://github.com/lukegalea/ash_a2ui/catalogs/admin/v3. openSurface states its allowedCallers (rendererOnly, the default). 3.0.0 includes every 2.0.0 component and property unchanged.
changelog.2.0.0: Breaking: the A2UI 1.0 wire (protocolVersion "1.0"). Bindings are {"@path": ...} and function calls {"@call": ...}; an admin surface names this catalog as its catalogId and its basic components carry the basic catalog's id as @catalogId; every envelope (row actions, row click, sort, pagination, calendar window) is sent as the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction function. The catalogId moves to https://github.com/lukegalea/ash_a2ui/catalogs/admin/v2, and this contract metadata moves under metadata.extensions.ash_a2ui. New: filterPicker, a query filter's picker (the ChoicePicker with hint, counts, dynamicOptions and grouped options). dataGrid columns' more declares textPath, captionPath and labelPath (the server-written tag text, list caption and accessible label). 2.0.0 includes every 1.x addition, up to and including 1.12 (record pages), 1.13 (plain links), 1.14 (grouped list rows), 1.15 (document rows and table footers), 1.16 (card rows), 1.17 (step fields) and 1.18 (table card headers).
changelog.1.18.0: Additive: table card headers. dataGrid gains an optional heading (the header of the table's own card, translated, present only when the table declares one; label stays the collection's accessible name and is not a heading) and an optional description (a one-line caption under the heading, above the rows, translated). A renderer draws both inside the table's card in every layout, and above the empty state when there are no rows. Renderers that ignore them leave them out. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.17.0: Additive: step fields. fieldDisplay gains an optional steps (a binding to a steps field's steps, /detail/<context>/_steps_<field>: a list of {number, label, text?, note?, state, stateLabel, line} objects, state one of complete, current, upcoming or overdue and stateLabel its words, translated), drawn as a numbered stepper. Renderers that ignore it draw the value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.16.0: Additive: card rows. dataGrid layout gains cards (one card per row: the title and badge head it, the other columns are labeled rows, and expand columns fold under a disclosure), the dataGrid an optional expandLabel (the words on that disclosure, translated) and columns an optional pairs (true: the value is a list of {term, value} objects, drawn as one labeled row each). Renderers that ignore them draw the grid. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.15.0: Additive: document rows and table footers. dataGrid columns gain the placement leading (a short code drawn before the row's title, such as a file's type); a plain link object may carry download: true (the address is a file to download, not a page to open); the dataGrid gains an optional footerNote (a binding to a line of text drawn under the rows, inside the table's card) and footerLink ({href, label}: a link beside it). Renderers that ignore them draw the column as any other, follow the link, and leave the footer out. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.14.0: Additive: grouped list rows. dataGrid columns gain the placements group (the value heading a group of consecutive rows) and groupSubtitle (the line under that heading, from the group's first row), and the dataGrid an optional groupIcon (an icon name for the group headers, resolved in the renderer's own icon set). Columns gain an optional emptyText (the field's empty_text: the muted words a list-rows renderer shows when the row's value is empty). A list-rows renderer starts a new group wherever the group value changes; renderers that ignore them draw the columns as any other. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.13.0: Additive: plain links. A link object may be {href, label} with no surface (a field's link_url): a page or address, followed as an ordinary link rather than opened as a surface. Renderers that require a surface skip it and draw the plain value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.12.0: Additive: record pages. fieldDisplay gains optional badge, badgeTone and badgeHelp (bindings to the field's _badge_<field>, _badge_tone_<field> and _badge_help_<field> under its /detail/<context> path: the value drawn as a pill with that tone and one-line tooltip), note (a few words beside the label saying how the value came to be), emptyText (the muted words shown when the value is empty) and hideWhenEmpty (true: an empty value draws no row at all). dataGrid gains an optional layout (rows: list rows instead of a grid) and columns an optional placement (trailing or expand: where a list-rows renderer draws them). Renderers that ignore them draw the plain value and the grid. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.11.0: Additive: the table's cells and sort. A badge column's badge gains an optional helpPath (row-relative, the _badge_help_<field> key: the pill's one-line tooltip, empty for none). dataGrid columns gain an optional caption ({path, text?}: a third line under the value and its subtitle, the text's {date} filled with the path's value formatted as a date and {value} with it as is; without text the line is the value) and sortFirst (desc when the header's first click sorts descending). The dataGrid's sort gains an optional reset: true, a header's third click then sends a null sort (the query's default order) instead of toggling back. Renderers that ignore them draw the pill without a tooltip, no third line, and toggle. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.10.0: Additive: the filter bar and the table header. dataGrid columns gain optional help ({title, body}: header help opened from an info mark; body paragraphs separated by blank lines, a line `**Term** — text` a definition) and sortField (the field a sortable header sorts by when it is not the column's path); a column's detail gains an optional helpPath (row-relative, the _detail_help_<column> key: an info mark with a tooltip after the line). dataGrid columns also gain optional width (px) and moreNoun, more gains valuesPath (the row's list of all the values), and rowClick an optional width. emptyState gains optional title, icon (inbox | search | archive), clearAction ({label, action}) and clearVisible. pagination gains optional pageSizeOptions (the sizes offered) and pageSizeAction (the query envelope sent with the picked pageSize and page 1). The basic inputs this catalog replaces accept more keys: ChoicePicker hint (a footer under the options), counts (a binding to a value → count map), dynamicOptions (a binding to an option list) and options carrying parent (their group's value) or group: true (a group: picking it picks all its leaves; only leaf values are written); TextField placeholder. An empty statusBanner takes no layout space. Badge and icon tones gain pending and gray. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.9.0: Additive: dataGrid rowClick gains optional labelPath and variantPath (row-relative: the row's _primary_label and _primary_variant keys) and inline. With inline the renderer also draws the row click as one button per row in a final column, its label and Button variant (default | primary | borderless) read from the row, dispatching the same envelope; the rowActions entry the row click mirrors is then left out. Without these the row click and rowActions are unchanged. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.8.0: Additive: dataGrid columns gain optional subtitle ({path}: a second line under the value), icon ({path, labelPath, tonePath?}: a leading icon picked per row from a small generic vocabulary), more ({path}: a count; 2 or more adds a "+N more" tag) and detail ({path, datePath?, iconPath?, iconTonePath?}: a detail line under the value, {date} filled in by the renderer, after an optional icon). The fields they read from ride in the row and are not columns of their own. Renderers that ignore them draw the plain value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.7.0: Additive: sortable headers. dataGrid columns gain an optional sortable flag (the field is in the table query's sortable allowlist), and the dataGrid an optional sort: the binding to the current sort ({field, dir} or null) and the query envelope a header click dispatches with the new sort. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.6.0: Additive: entityPage gains an optional headerVisible boolean. false leaves the page header (title and description) out, for a host page that already owns the heading; omitted means true. The title stays required. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.5.0: Additive: calendarView gains an optional granularities list (the window sizes the user may switch between); the renderer offers a switch and dispatches windowAction with granularity added. The window state carries the size it shows. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.4.0: Additive: the liveDiagram component (diagram entities): a mermaid diagram (static source) with markers bound by node id, and the node list a renderer without mermaid shows instead. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.3.0: Additive: the calendarView component (display :calendar tables): the table's query window as a month or week grid, or one day, with the days that hold records marked, wrapping the table's dataGrid. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.2.0: Additive: dataGrid rowActions entries gain an optional visiblePath (per-row visibility of visible_when actions) and an optional prompt (prompt_fields actions collect their values in a dialog over a grid child before the invoke). The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.1.0: Additive: dataGrid columns gain optional format/align/mono/badge/link and the grid an optional rowClick envelope; fieldDisplay gains an optional link binding; the openSurface client function. Renderers that read only columns[label, path] are unaffected; the catalogId is unchanged (no breaking change).

entityPage.description: Page shell for an admin resource surface: title, optional description, and the page body (context pickers, query controls, DataGrid, RecordPanel, StatusBanner).

title.description: Page title: a literal string or a data-model path binding.

description.description: Optional page description: a literal string or a data-model path binding.

children.description: Ids of the page body components, in order.

headerVisible.description: Optional (1.6). false leaves the page header (title and description) out, for a host page that already owns the heading; omitted means true.

header.description: Optional (3.5): the page header the surface declares, drawn in place of the plain heading (headerVisible does not hide it). Its words are translated; every other value is read from the header's record at path, by field name, when the record is written.

context.description: The context whose record the header reads.

title.description: The field holding the page's title, the breadcrumb's last step.

breadcrumb.description: The steps before the title: {label, href?, pagePath?, live?}. pagePath (/page/<key>) names a host page value that, when present, is the step's address instead of href. live (3.7), navigate or patch, makes the step a live link: the renderer puts data-a2ui-live=<live> on the link it draws, and the AshA2ui hook follows a plain click on it inside the LiveView.

tags.description: Tags in the line under the title, before meta: {field, tone?, icon?, iconField?, help?, helpField?, helpLabel?}. field holds the text (empty hides the item), tone a field holding the tone (info, success, warning, danger, neutral, pending, accent or gray), icon or iconField an icon name, help or helpField a tooltip, helpLabel the accessible name of an info mark the tooltip hangs from.

meta.description: Lines of text in the line under the title, after the tags; the same shape as tags.

actions.description: The header's buttons: {name, label, variant, href?, visible?, title?, action?}. variant is primary, secondary or quiet. A link's href names the field holding its address (no address, no button); visible names a boolean field (the button shows while it is true). A button that runs an action carries action, an envelope {label, action: page_action, context: {action, recordId, contexts?}} dispatched as the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction with its bindings resolved, and visible is _header_action_<name>; the server re-checks every call.

lead.description: Optional (3.5): ids drawn full width under the page header, before the children and beside no section nav. They are not among the children.

leadVisible.description: Optional (3.5): per lead id, the data-model path of a boolean; that lead component is drawn only while it is true.

nav.description: Optional (3.5): a sticky section nav beside the children: {label, id?, items: [{label, anchor, target, id?}]}. target is the id of the section a choice scrolls to the line the nav starts on (outlined for three seconds); anchor its #anchor, which a link anywhere on the page or the address on arrival also goes to, once the section is drawn. The entry of the section in view is marked selected.

dataGrid.description: Collection view over one table's records. Rows come from the bound records list; row identity is the rowId data path. Row actions dispatch their envelopes via the rowActions entries (View/Edit start the record tasks; declared row actions reuse their existing invoke envelopes, destructive when the action is a destroy — the renderer confirms through ConfirmDialog before dispatching unchanged).

columns.description: One entry per visible field, in field order: {label: string, path: string} where path is row-relative (the cell value's key on the row object). Optional presentation hints (1.1): format, align, mono, badge, link — renderers that ignore them still render correct cells from label/path.

format.description: Cell formatting hint, as fieldDisplay's format; text when omitted.

align.description: Cell alignment; numbers are end-aligned. start when omitted.

mono.description: true for identifier columns (ids, UUIDs): render in a monospaced face.

badge.description: Render the cell as a status pill. path (row-relative) is the pill's display text (the server-computed _badge_<field> key); tonePath (row-relative, optional) is the row's semantic tone (the _badge_tone_<field> key): neutral | info | success | warning | danger | accent. Without tonePath (or an unknown tone) the pill is neutral.

link.description: Row-relative binding ({path: "_links/<field>"}) to the cell's reference link(s): a link object {surface, recordId, label[, href]}, or (1.13) a plain link {href, label} with no surface (1.15: with download: true when the address is a file to download), or a list of them (multi-valued links). Absent on a row = no link for that row (pruned per actor). Activating a link invokes the openSurface function with {surface, recordId}.

review.description: Optional (3.3): row-relative binding ({path: "_review_<field>"}) to the row's review of the column's field: {state, stateLabel, page?, pageLabel?, href?, quote?} or null, as fieldDisplay's review. state is pending (filled in automatically, not checked yet), reviewed (a person checked it) or missing (looked for, not found), stateLabel the state in words (translated), page the source page the value came from (from 1), pageLabel its tag (translated), href an address opening the source at that place and quote the words the value was read from. When present a pending value is highlighted and the state is written out, not only coloured, beside the page tag (a link when href is present). Null or absent on a row = no review for that row.

action.description: Optional (3.9): the field action of the column's field, a button in each row beside the value. Shaped like fieldDisplay's action and a rowActions entry, dispatched the same way (the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction, context bindings resolved against the row at click time).

label.description: The action's name in words (translated): the button's text, or its accessible name and tooltip when it draws as an icon.

action.description: The client action name dispatched: field_action.

context.description: The action context: component (the table), field, recordId (bound row-relatively to the row's id), and query and contexts (bound to /query and /context on surfaces that have them).

icon.description: Optional: an icon name the button may draw as ("check").

actionVisible.description: Optional (3.9): row-relative binding ({path: "_action_<field>"}) to whether the row offers the column's action, a boolean. The button shows only while it is true; the server re-checks every call.

masked.description: Optional (3.12): row-relative binding ({path: "_masked/<field>"}) to the row's masked-field reason, a string — why the reader may not see the value ("You do not have access to this value.", translated). When it resolves to a non-empty string the cell's value is itself the masked text ("Hidden", translated) and draws as plain text: format, link, badge, edit, emptyText and hideWhenEmpty are ignored (a value the reader may not see is not edited in place), the element is marked data-a2ui-masked, and the reason is its title and accessible description. Absent or empty on a row = the value is not masked.

sortable.description: Optional (1.7): true when the table's query lets the client sort by this column (the field is in its sortable allowlist). The renderer makes the header a sort control driven by the dataGrid's sort. Absent = not sortable.

subtitle.description: Optional (1.8): row-relative binding to a second line drawn under the cell's value (a column's subtitle field). Absent or empty on a row = no second line. reviewPath (optional, 3.3, row-relative) names the subtitle field's review on the row (the _review_<field> key), shaped as the column's review.

icon.description: Optional (1.8): a leading icon picked per row. path (row-relative) is the icon name (the server-computed _icon_<column> key): check | x | user_check | user_x | alert | clock | info | refresh | extend, empty for none; labelPath its accessible label (_icon_label_<column>); tonePath (optional) its tone (_icon_tone_<column>), from the badge tone vocabulary. Renderers map the names onto their own icons.

more.description: Optional (1.8): row-relative binding to how many values the cell's field has. When it is 2 or more the renderer adds a tag counting the rest ("+N more", N = count - 1). valuesPath (optional, 1.10) names the row's list of all the values (the _more_values_<column> key, strings), for a list of them. textPath, captionPath and labelPath (row-relative, optional) name the server-written words: the tag's text (the _more_text_<column> key, pluralized for the reader), the list's caption (_more_caption_<column>) and the tag's accessible label (_more_label_<column>).

detail.description: Optional (1.8): a detail line drawn under the cell's value (under the pill on a badge column). path (row-relative) is its text (the server-computed _detail_<column> key, empty for none); datePath (row-relative, optional) a date the renderer formats in the reader's locale and puts in place of {date}; iconPath and iconTonePath (row-relative, optional) the icon drawn before the line and its tone (the _detail_icon_<column> and _detail_icon_tone_<column> keys, from the same icon and tone vocabularies; decorative); helpPath (row-relative, optional, 1.10) the line's explanation (the _detail_help_<column> key), drawn as an info mark with a tooltip, empty for none.

help.description: Optional (1.10): the column's header help, drawn as an info mark after the label opening title and body. body paragraphs are separated by blank lines; a line `**Term** — text` is a definition.

width.description: Optional (1.10): a fixed column width in pixels.

moreNoun.description: Optional (1.10): the plural noun captioning the list of more values ("3 properties").

sortField.description: Optional (1.10): the field a sortable header sorts by (sent as the query's sort field and matched against the current sort) when it is not the column's path.

sortFirst.description: Optional (1.11): the direction a sortable header's first click sorts in when it is not ascending.

pairs.description: Optional (1.16): true when the value is a list of {term, value} objects: a renderer draws one labeled row per pair.

items.description: Optional (3.10), with pairs: row-relative binding ({path: "_pairs_<field>"}) to the row's normalized pairs, a list of {term, value, key?, review?, action?}: review in a review field's shape (3.1), drawn after the item's value; key the item's address in the record; action whether the item offers the column's pairAction, a boolean. Drawn instead of the raw value when present.

pairAction.description: Optional (3.10), with pairs: the field action of the column's field as a button per item, offered while the item's action is true. Shaped like the column's action (3.9) and dispatched the same way (the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction, context bindings resolved against the row at click time), with the item's key added to the context as item.

label.description: The action's name in words (translated): the button's text, or its accessible name and tooltip when it draws as an icon.

action.description: The client action name dispatched: field_action.

context.description: The action context: component (the table), field, recordId (bound row-relatively to the row's id), and query and contexts (bound to /query and /context on surfaces that have them). The renderer adds item, the chosen item's key.

icon.description: Optional: an icon name the button may draw as ("check").

emptyText.description: Optional (1.14): the muted words a list-rows renderer shows for the column when a row's value is empty (the field's empty_text).

placement.description: Optional (1.12): where a list-rows renderer (layout rows) draws the column: trailing at the row's end, right-aligned; expand only when the row is opened. 1.14: group heads each run of consecutive rows sharing its value; groupSubtitle sits under that heading. 1.15: leading is a short code drawn before the row's title. Grids draw it as any other column.

caption.description: Optional (1.11): a third line under the cell's value and subtitle. path (row-relative) is the caption field's value; text (optional, translated) the line's words, {date} replaced with the value formatted as a date in the reader's locale and {value} with it as is. Without text the line is the value; an empty value draws no line.

rows.description: Binding to the table's records list path (e.g. {"@path": "/records"}).

layout.description: Optional (1.12): rows asks for list rows instead of a grid: no header, each row its title (and subtitle), badge, trailing columns, and a disclosure opening its expand columns. 1.16: cards asks for one card per row, headed by its title and badge, its other columns as labeled rows and its expand columns under a disclosure. Renderers that ignore it draw the grid.

heading.description: Optional (1.18): the header of the table's own card ("Order lines"), translated; present only when the table declares one. Drawn above the rows (or the empty state), inside the card, in every layout.

description.description: Optional (1.18): a one-line caption under the card's heading, above the rows (or the empty state), muted; translated.

expandLabel.description: Optional (1.16): the words on the disclosure that opens a row's expand columns ("Show notes"), translated.

footerNote.description: Optional (1.15): binding to a line of text a renderer draws under the rows, inside the table's card (a field of the table's context record, at /detail/<context>/<field>).

footerLink.description: Optional (1.15): a link a renderer draws beside the footer note: {href, label}.

groupIcon.description: Optional (1.14): an icon name for a list-rows renderer's group headers ("home"), resolved in the renderer's own icon set.

rowId.description: Row-relative data path for row identity ("id").

rowActions.description: Action envelopes reusing the existing button context shape: {label, action, context} plus destructive: true on destroys.

action.description: The client action name dispatched (view_record, start_edit, or invoke).

context.description: The action context: literal values and {"@path": ...} bindings resolved against the row (recordId, component, action, values).

destructive.description: true when dispatch must be confirmed through ConfirmDialog (destroy actions).

visiblePath.description: Optional (1.2): row-relative path of the action's per-row visibility (the server-computed _visible_<action> key of a visible_when action). The renderer offers the action only on rows where the value is a non-empty list (or true); absent means always offered. Enforcement stays server-side.

prompt.description: Optional (1.2): the action collects values first (prompt_fields). Activating it dispatches the open envelope (the server pre-fills /prompt/values/<action>), shows the content child (a grid child holding the prompt's inputs) in a dialog headed title, and on confirm dispatches this rowActions entry itself — the invoke envelope whose context binds values to /prompt/values/<action>. The dialog stays open on an error outcome and closes on success.

content.description: Id of the dataGrid child holding the prompt inputs (bound to /prompt/values/<action>/<field>).

open.description: The prompt pre-fill envelope, in the flat rowActions shape ({action: "prompt", context}), resolved against the row.

rowClick.description: Optional (1.1): the row's primary action envelope — byte-identical to its rowActions entry (the select_context entry when declared, else View). Activating the row (outside its buttons and links) dispatches it, resolved against the row like a rowActions entry.

labelPath.description: Optional (1.9): row-relative path of the row's button label (the _primary_label key); label when absent on a row.

variantPath.description: Optional (1.9): row-relative path of the row's Button variant (the _primary_variant key): default | primary | borderless. default when absent or unknown.

inline.description: Optional (1.9): true to also draw the row click as one button per row in a final column (label from labelPath, variant from variantPath), dispatching the same envelope. The rowActions entry the row click mirrors is then left out of rowActions. Whole-row activation is unchanged.

width.description: Optional (1.10): the inline button column's fixed width in pixels.

sort.description: Optional (1.7), present when a column is sortable: path binds the table's current sort ({field, dir} with dir asc | desc, or null; e.g. {"path": "/query/sort"}); action is the query envelope ({name: "query", context}, the Apply envelope with page 1) a sortable header dispatches after setting sort in the resolved query state to {field: <column path>, dir}. The renderer marks the sorted column (aria-sort) and toggles asc/desc on repeat clicks. The server validates the sort against the same allowlist.

reset.description: Optional (1.11): a header's clicks cycle first direction, the other, then back to the query's default order (the action sent with sort null).

children.description: At most one emptyState and at most one pagination child.

emptyState.description: Zero-results state for a DataGrid. The renderer shows it only while the grid's bound rows list is empty — no sentinel prop.

message.description: The empty-state text (e.g. "No Tasks records yet."): a literal string or a data-model path binding.

title.description: Optional (1.10): the empty state's heading, a literal or a binding (the query state's emptyState/title).

icon.description: Optional (1.10): inbox | search | archive, a literal or a binding (emptyState/icon).

clearAction.description: Optional (1.10): {label, action}: a button that clears the query state's search, filters and ranges at action.context.query.path, then dispatches action (the query envelope at page 1).

clearVisible.description: Optional (1.10): whether the clear action shows (bound to emptyState/clear: true while search or filters are active).

pagination.description: Conditional pagination navigation. All data props are plain values or bindings — no zero-or-one sentinel lists. Visibility is decided server-side (the query state's boolean keys); the renderer hides the whole bar when visible is false.

page.description: Current 1-based page (bound to the query state).

pageSize.description: Page size (bound to the query state).

total.description: Total matching records when known, null otherwise (bound).

visible.description: Whether the bar renders at all: page > 1 or hasNext (bound to the query state's paginationVisible).

previousVisible.description: Whether the previous affordance renders (bound to previousVisible).

nextVisible.description: Whether the next affordance renders (bound to nextVisible).

previousAction.description: The previous-page action envelope: the existing `query` action with pageDelta -1.

nextAction.description: The next-page action envelope: the existing `query` action with pageDelta 1.

pageSizeOptions.description: Optional (1.10): the page sizes the reader may pick (the query's page_size_options).

pageSizeAction.description: Optional (1.10): the `query` action envelope (page 1) the renderer dispatches with the picked size as the query state's pageSize.

recordPanel.description: Explicit task panel for one record. Hidden while the bound mode is null (renderer concern). The renderer shows the fieldDisplay children in view mode and the formSection + actionBar children in create/edit mode.

children.description: One fieldDisplay per field, then the formSection and actionBar.

fieldDisplay.description: Read-only value display for view mode — text semantics, never a disabled input.

format.description: Optional value formatting hint; text when omitted. Text values that are lists (arrays, or multi-line text whose lines are bulleted with -, * or •) render as lists.

link.description: Optional (1.1): binding to the field's reference link(s) — a link object {surface, recordId, label[, href]}, or (1.13) a plain link {href, label} with no surface (1.15: with download: true when the address is a file to download), or a list of them (e.g. {"@path": "/detail/<context>/_links/<field>"}). When present the value renders as link(s) activating the openSurface function (a plain link is followed); when the bound value is absent the plain value renders.

badge.description: Optional (1.12): binding to the badge text of a badge field (/detail/<context>/_badge_<field>): the value is drawn as a pill with this text.

badgeTone.description: Optional (1.12): binding to the badge tone (/detail/<context>/_badge_tone_<field>): neutral, info, success, warning, danger, accent, pending or gray.

badgeHelp.description: Optional (1.12): binding to the badge's one-line tooltip (/detail/<context>/_badge_help_<field>); empty for none.

note.description: Optional (1.12): a few words beside the label saying how the value came to be ("Calculated"), translated.

emptyText.description: Optional (1.12): the muted words shown in place of an empty value (null or ""), translated.

hideWhenEmpty.description: Optional (1.12): true when an empty value (null or "") draws no row at all.

steps.description: Optional (1.17): binding to a steps field's steps (/detail/<context>/_steps_<field>), a list of {number, label, text?, note?, state, stateLabel, line}: number is the step's place (from 1), text the line under the label, note a smaller line, state one of complete, current, upcoming or overdue, stateLabel the state in words (translated) and line the whole step as one line of text. When present the value draws as a numbered stepper with each step's state written out, not only coloured; an empty list is an empty value (emptyText, hideWhenEmpty).

action.description: Optional (3.2): the field's action, a button beside the value. Shaped like a dataGrid rowActions entry and dispatched the same way (the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction, context bindings resolved at click time).

label.description: The action's name in words (translated): the button's text, or its accessible name and tooltip when it draws as an icon.

action.description: The client action name dispatched: field_action.

context.description: The action context: component (the detail card), field, recordId (bound to /detail/<context>/id) and contexts (bound to /context on surfaces with contexts).

icon.description: Optional: an icon name the button may draw as ("check").

actionVisible.description: Optional (3.2): binding to whether the record offers the field's action (/detail/<context>/_action_<field>, a boolean). The button shows only while it is true; the server re-checks every call.

review.description: Optional (3.1): binding to a review field's review (/detail/<context>/_review_<field>), an object {state, stateLabel, page?, pageLabel?, href?, quote?} or null: state is pending (filled in automatically, not checked yet), reviewed (a person checked it) or missing (looked for, not found), stateLabel the state in words (translated), page the source page the value came from (from 1), pageLabel its tag (translated), href an address opening the source at that place and quote the words the value was read from. When present a pending value is highlighted and the state is written out, not only coloured, beside the page tag (a link when href is present). From 3.4 it may carry boxes ([{page, x, y, width, height}], fractions of the page): where the value sits in a documentPane's document; its href then opens the pane there.

edit.description: Optional (3.11): the field is edited in place. While editVisible is true, choosing or focusing the value opens it as an input of kind input, starting from editDraft when there is one, else editValue. Enter or leaving it with a changed value writes the value to editDraft and the card's recordId (resolved now) to /ui/edits/<component>/recordId; leaving it unchanged closes it; Escape closes it and drops the change. A value back at editValue removes the draft. Nothing is sent: a saveBar saves.

component.description: The detail card the field is on.

input.description: The input: text, a whole number, a number, a date (YYYY-MM-DD), or one of options.

options.description: A choice input's options, labels translated.

editValue.description: Optional (3.11): binding to the stored value the input starts from (/detail/<context>/_edit_<field>): the attribute behind a formatted value.

editVisible.description: Optional (3.11): binding to whether the record offers editing on the card (/detail/<context>/_editable_<card>, a boolean). The value is read-only while it is not true; the server re-checks every save.

editDraft.description: Optional (3.11): binding to the person's unsaved change (/ui/edits/<card>/values/<field>), absent while there is none. While present the value shows the draft, marked as changed.

editError.description: Optional (3.11): binding to a refused save's message for the field (/ui/edit_errors/<card>/<field>), shown at the input.

masked.description: Optional (3.12): binding to the record's masked-field reason (/detail/<context>/_masked/<field> or /ui/panel/record/_masked/<field>), a string — why the reader may not see the value ("You do not have access to this value.", translated). When it resolves to a non-empty string the value is itself the masked text ("Hidden", translated) and draws as plain text: format, link, badge, edit, emptyText and hideWhenEmpty are ignored (a value the reader may not see is not edited in place), the element is marked data-a2ui-masked, and the reason is its title and accessible description. Absent or empty = the value is not masked.

saveBar.description: 3.11: the bar pinned to the bottom of the page while a person has unsaved changes (/ui/edits holds a draft). It counts the fields under review still waiting, discards the changes, or saves them all through its action (the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction save_changes, its context's bindings resolved at click time, choice added). A confirm opens a dialog first while fields still wait.

messageWaiting.description: Optional: the message while fields under review still wait, translated.

status.description: Optional: a tag counting the fields still waiting, shown while any wait; %{count} is replaced. Translated.

statusOne.description: Optional: the tag when one field waits, translated.

edits.description: Binding to the unsaved changes, /ui/edits: {<card>: {recordId, values: {<field>: value}}}.

record.description: Binding to the bar's record (/detail/<context>): its _review_<field> states and its thenVisible field.

reviews.description: The fields under review the bar counts: each {component, field}, read at the record's _review_<field>. One waits while its state is pending or missing (and, with editReviews, it has no draft).

editReviews.description: Whether a field with a draft no longer counts as waiting: saving it reviews it.

action.description: The save envelope: {action: save_changes, context: {edits, recordId, contexts?}}; the renderer adds choice (save or then).

confirm.description: Optional: the dialog a Save opens while fields still wait. title/message (and their One forms for one field) with %{count} replaced; Cancel (and Escape, close, backdrop) sends nothing; saveLabel sends choice save; thenLabel, while then is true and the record's thenVisible field is true (or no thenVisible), sends choice then. thenWhenClear: with nothing waiting, Save sends choice then when it is offered.

domId.description: Optional: a DOM id for the bar.

formSection.description: Labeled field grouping for create/edit mode. Children are basic-catalog input components (text_field, check_box, choice_picker, date_time_input) with the exact per-field bindings and /errors/<field> associations the basic form emission produces.

children.description: Ids of the basic inputs, their error texts, and any basic group cards.

actionBar.description: Action hierarchy for the record panel: the primary action (hidden while the bound primaryLabel is empty) plus secondary buttons. The primary dispatches the existing submit_form envelope; secondaries are basic buttons (Cancel dispatches cancel_record_task).

primaryLabel.description: Bound to /ui/panel/primary_label — empty means the primary action is hidden.

busy.description: Reserved for pending-state binding; false for now.

destructive.description: Styles the primary action as destructive (default false).

action.description: The primary action envelope: the existing submit_form event.

children.description: Ids of the secondary basic buttons.

alertBanner.description: Additive (3.5): a :detail component drawn as an alert about the record: a title, a message and an optional link, toned by variant. Draws nothing while it has neither a title nor a message.

layout.description: inline sits with the content around it; section spans the page, its link at the end.

message.description: Optional: binding to the text, a field of the record (/detail/<context>/<field>).

linkHref.description: Optional: binding to the link's address (#<anchor> for a place on the page). No address, no link.

linkLabel.description: Optional: binding to the link's words.

count.description: Optional (3.6): a review summary's count, binding to /detail/<context>/_review_summary_<component>/count: how many review fields still wait (pending or missing). Its linkHref and linkLabel then bind to the same summary's href (the first waiting field's section, or the fallback) and label.

statusBanner.description: Typed feedback banner. Renders nothing while the bound kind is null (renderer concern; success and warning → role=status, error → role=alert).

kind.description: Bound to /ui/feedback/kind: "success", "warning" (partial success of a bulk run), "error", or null.

confirmDialog.description: Destructive-action confirmation. Declared in the catalog vocabulary and rendered by the DataGrid renderer when a rowAction envelope carries destructive: true; confirming dispatches the original envelope unchanged — the server never sees a new action name. Confirm/cancel are handled client-side before dispatch.

destructive.description: Styles the confirm action as destructive (default true).

calendarView.description: Calendar over one display :calendar table (1.3). Shows the query window (a month or week grid, or one day) with the days that hold records marked and the picked day selected. Its child is the table's dataGrid, which lists the window's records, or the picked day's. Moving the window and picking a day dispatch windowAction with anchor (an ISO date inside the window the renderer now shows) or date (the picked ISO date, "" to clear) added to its context; the server re-reads and writes the window state back.

label.description: Accessible name of the calendar (the table's collection label).

granularity.description: The window size declared on the table (the one it opens on). The window state's own granularity, when present, is the one shown.

granularities.description: Optional (1.5): the window sizes the user may switch between. With more than one the renderer offers a switch that dispatches windowAction with granularity (one of these) added.

window.description: Binding to the table's window state ({"@path": "/query/<table>/window"}): {granularity, anchor, from, to, selected, label, scopeLabel, marks: [{date, count, label}]}.

windowAction.description: The query envelope {name: "query", context: {query: {path}, component, contexts?}} the calendar dispatches with anchor or date added.

children.description: The id of the table's dataGrid.

liveDiagram.description: A live diagram (1.4): the mermaid source, drawn once with securityLevel strict, and markers placed on the nodes they name. Marker moves are data-model writes to the bound markers; the diagram itself does not re-render. A renderer that cannot draw mermaid renders the bound node list. A marker's link (server-resolved, never client input) opens through the openSurface function.

description.description: Optional help text under the heading.

markers.description: Binding to the markers keyed by node id ({"@path": "/diagram/<name>/markers"}): {<nodeId>: [{id, nodeId, nodeLabel, label, initials, status: active|executing|waiting|failed|done, statusLabel, tone: neutral|info|success|warning|danger|accent, link?: {surface, recordId, label, href?}}]}.

nodes.description: Binding to the node list ({"@path": "/diagram/<name>/nodes"}): [{id, label, count, markers}], the nodes that hold markers.

error.description: Binding to the unavailable message ("" when the diagram loaded).

documentPane.description: A document pane (3.4): a record's source document beside the surface's sections. The renderer draws the children alone while the pane is hidden (shown false, the default) and, while shown, the children beside the viewer component (roughly one part to two), stacked where there is no room for both. A switch labelled label (description beside it) shows and hides it: the renderer writes shown at once and sends toggleAction with shown added. The switch is drawn only while document is not null. A link inside the children whose href starts with regionHref ("#document=") opens the pane at the region it names (the rest of the href, URL-encoded): the renderer shows the pane if it is hidden (sending toggleAction), writes selected and sends the viewer's regionAction. A review field's page tag links this way when the field's citation has boxes. 3.8: while shown with the document beside the children, an element the renderer drew for a value carrying data-a2ui-region (the regions' hrefs, separated by spaces) links both ways with the viewer: pointing at or focusing inside it shows its regions linked (only the viewer's canvas scrolls; nothing is written or sent), and activating one of those regions scrolls the page to it and flashes it.

pane.description: The pane's name (the document_pane entity), sent in its actions.

description.description: Optional words beside the switch, translated.

document.description: Binding to the record's document (/detail/<context>/_document_<name>): {src, fileName, regions} or null when the record has none.

shown.description: Binding to whether the pane is shown (/ui/documents/<name>/shown).

selected.description: Binding to the region a person went to (/ui/documents/<name>/selected), or null.

regionHref.description: The href prefix of a link to one of the pane's regions ("#<url_param>=").

toggleAction.description: The document_pane event ({name, context: {pane}}), sent with shown added.

viewer.description: The documentViewer drawn beside the children.

documentViewer.description: A document viewer (3.4): the pages of the PDF at src, drawn by the renderer (pdf.js, loaded only when a viewer has a document to open), each with a text layer assistive technology reads, with zoom and page navigation, and regions outlined on the pages. A region is {id, page, x, y, width, height, state, label?}: its box as fractions of its page from the top-left corner, state one of pending, reviewed, selected, reviewed-selected, linked or empty, and label what it holds (translated). Regions sharing an id are one region drawn in several places. The region whose id is selected is drawn selected (pending) or reviewed-selected (reviewed) and scrolled into view. Activating a region (click, Enter or Space) writes selected and sends regionAction with regionId added. No editing and no signing happen in the viewer.

src.description: The address of the PDF, fetched by the browser as the reader.

fileName.description: The file name shown above the pages.

regions.description: Binding to the regions ([{id, page, x, y, width, height, state, label?}]).

selected.description: Binding to the selected region's id, or null.

regionAction.description: The document_region event ({name, context: {pane}}), sent with regionId added.

strings.description: The viewer's own words, translated: loading, failed, pageOf and pageLabel (with %{page} and %{count} for the renderer to fill), previousPage, nextPage, zoomIn, zoomOut, and the state words pending, reviewed and empty.

filterPicker.description: A query filter's picker: the basic ChoicePicker plus what an admin filter carries. hint is a line of help under the picker; counts binds a value-to-count map (the filter's facet counts); dynamicOptions binds an option list from the query state (a path filter's options, shown after the static ones); an option may be a group (group: true) or a group's leaf (parent: the group's value). The value binds the query state's filter (a string list, or a scalar the renderer reads as a one-item list).

parent.description: The value of the group this option belongs to.

group.description: true for a group heading option.

hint.description: A line of help shown under the picker.

counts.description: Binding to the filter's facet counts ({value: count}).

dynamicOptions.description: Binding to options read from the query state ([{label, value}]).

label.description: The text label for the input field.

value.description: The value of the text field.

placeholder.description: The placeholder text for the input field.

variant.description: The type of input field to display.

label.description: The text to display next to the checkbox.

value.description: The current state of the checkbox (true for checked, false for unchecked).

ChoicePicker.description: A component that allows selecting one or more options from a list.

label.description: The label for the group of options.

variant.description: A hint for how the choice picker should be displayed and behave.

options.description: The list of available options to choose from.

label.description: The text to display for this option.

value.description: The stable value associated with this option.
The list of currently selected values. This should be bound to a string array in the data model.

displayStyle.description: The display style of the component.

filterable.description: If true, displays a search input to filter the options.

value.description: The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. If not yet set, initialize with an empty string.

enableDate.description: If true, allows the user to select a date.

enableTime.description: If true, allows the user to select a time.

min.description: The minimum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

max.description: The maximum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

label.description: The text label for the input field.

trigger.description: The ID of the component that opens the modal when interacted with (e.g., a button).

content.description: The ID of the component to be displayed inside the modal.

openSurface.description: Opens another surface on a record — the reference-link navigation. The client decides how (the web renderer hands it to the host: by default the LiveView navigates to the configured open_surface_url; other clients may stack the surface and return with a back key). No return value.

surface.description: The target surface key (the link's surface).

recordId.description: The target record's id (the link's recordId); omitted to open the surface itself.

query.description: Optional initial state for the target surface (e.g. {"ctx": {"person": "<id>"}}).

headerItem.description: One item of a page header's line under the title (3.5): field holds its text, read from the header's record; the rest are optional.

actionEvent.description: An ash_a2ui action the renderer sends as ashAction: its name and its context, whose bindings resolve against the data model (row-relative inside a dataGrid row).

Weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.
